metadata.title: Oklo Stock Jumps on Promising Updates on Its Novel Nuclear Reactors<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nuclear Reactor Firm Oklo Beats Earnings Expectations. That’s Not Why the Stock Is Up.
Shares of nuclear reactor start-up Oklo, formerly chaired by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, closed sharply higher Friday following its third quarter earnings report.
